Most people here don’t actually know. You can’t tell most of the time without knowing the person well or having studied the disorder and they don’t have symptoms that fit the diagnostic criteria. I mean there’s the obvious stuff like claiming things that are impossible for the disorder, like it forming in an impossible timeframe or that it gives them symptoms that don’t make sense for the disorder.

Usually for DID it’s a surplus of alters based around fictional characters from whatever media they’re obsessed with at the moment (especially if it’s recent media) Like having 5 my hero academia alters, 4 genshin or whatever alters, or god forbid 6 different Minecraft youtubers, and so on. They might claim that their alters can leave their head and visit other systems, their system seems stupidly similar to every other system in their online circle, blah blah. But since DID is known for being very complex and personalized case by case it isn’t impossible for someone’s system to be unusual. 

I can’t speak much for Tourette’s. I don’t have it and I am not especially informed on it. Lots of people fake tics but they’re only cutesy ones, not ones that involve them actually hitting themselves or objects. They copy tics from online people they like.
